text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Ikuno Dictus talking with a fellow
student
at the central plaza.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Ergo, it would be best for you to
reduce the
number of exercises in your
afternoon training
session by one.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I see! That'll definitely work! Thank you,
Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No need to thank me. I'm happy to be of
service.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The younger Umamusume gives Ikuno
Dictus a
deep bow and walks away.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
She wanted me to look over her training
schedule.
choice_data_list: 何か相談にのってたの？

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm quite good at schedule creation and

management, you see.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm quite good at schedule creation and

management, you see.
choice_data_list: 俺のスケジュールも見て欲しい
私のスケジュールも見て欲しい
choice_data_list_en: I want you to look at my schedule, too.
I'd like you to take a look at my schedule too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You want me to look at your schedule
too?
choice_data_list: 俺のスケジュールも見て欲しい
私のスケジュールも見て欲しい
choice_data_list_en: I want you to look at my schedule, too.
I'd like you to take a look at my schedule too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
But as a trainer, you must have already
learned
about schedule management.
There shouldn't be
a need for me to
examine it at all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hm... Very well. I'll take a look at it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...You've included too many activities for
this
day.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And while I understand you're busy, you
must find
time to eat, sleep, and rest.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Your body is an invaluable asset, even if
you
don't use it for racing like us. You
should ensure
you are never lacking in
nutrition, sleep, or rest.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No need for thanks. I'm merely glad to
be of help.
choice_data_list: ありがとう、参考にさせてもらうよ
choice_data_list_en: Thanks, I'll take that into consideration.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Now, on to my next point...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm not even halfway through my
comments. I
cannot simply let you get
away with this
ridiculous schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus proceeds to point out each
and
every flaw in my schedule...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Tips? Well, if it's one thing I would
advise, it
would be not to believe
everything you read.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Nine times out of ten, the benefits
of a
routine are what is emphasized.
choice_data_list_en: Aren't you worried you'll get tricked?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Often do I read that running a lot is the
key to
strengthen one's legs.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, in most cases, schedules do
not account
for the fatigue that is
brought on by exercise.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's all I wanted to point out. I don't
know if it
can be considered a tip, but I
hope it helps.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Good. That is wise of you.
choice_data_list: ありがとう、騙されないよう気をつけるよ
choice_data_list_en: Thanks, I'll make sure not to get tricked.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Except everything I just said was a lie.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I'm joking. What I told you was
all true.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, it seems you need more
practice in
being less gullible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus's stoicism belies a hidden
and
unexpected sense of humor. It'll
take a great deal
of practice to tell
when she's joking.
